videos.script: Some rules depend on several things at once. {{several}} At the Vila, the price of an order depends on three questions. {{price}} Is the buyer a student? Is the account a member's? Are there five tickets or more? {{questions}} Neither technique in this lesson needs the code. Both start from the requirement, and the answers are written down before anything runs. {{requirement}} Three yes-or-no questions make eight combinations. {{eight}} A decision table lists all eight, and says what each one should cost. {{table}} You run the eight, and one of them charges the wrong amount. {{wrong}} The second technique is for things that change over time. {{time}} An order is reserved, then paid, then used at the door. {{order}} A state diagram draws every state and every move between them. {{diagram}} Its table also lists the moves that should be impossible. Those are worth trying. {{forbidden}} One of them works when it should not, and it puts sold seats back on sale. {{seats}}
